text:
Bremen’s median asking rent sits at 11.38 €/m², up 2.6 % year‑on‑year and 25.5 % over the past five years, placing the city 19th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² typical apartment costs about 683 € per month, with a rent‑burden of 15.2 % for two residents.

The market remains balanced: listings spend an average of 26 days on the market, 29 % are let within a week and vacancy stands at 2.0 %. Asking rents are roughly 47 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 7.75 €/m², reflecting limited supply relative to modest 0.8 % population growth.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 12.09 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.73 €/m² and 12.47 €/m², implying a 6.3 % increase.
